import { EntityLookupService } from './EntityLookupService';
import { OrderDto, toOrderDto } from './OrderDto';

export class GetOrderUseCase {
  constructor(private readonly lookup: EntityLookupService) {}

  execute(orderId: string): OrderDto {
    return toOrderDto(this.lookup.requireOrder(orderId));
  }
}
